auditMetadata.title: Project Storage Migration, Backup & Archive Architecture Audit

summaryVariables.PROJECT_STORAGE_PROFILE: Firestore-managed entity settings defining current storage location, provider mode (My Drive vs Shared Drive), health status, and migration state.
summaryVariables.ARCHIVE_STRUCTURE: Q-PRJ-001_PROJECT_ARCHIVE_<timestamp>.zip containing manifest, json datasets (project, roster, pricing, trips, exceptions, audit), and subdirectories (reports/, imports/, printable-documents/).
summaryVariables.MASTER_SHEET_MIGRATION: REBUILD_AND_RESYNC: Instantiate fresh Master Sheet in target location, set 6 localized tabs, and run full Firestore projection sync. Preserves 100% data integrity.
summaryVariables.FILE_COPY_STRATEGY: RECURSIVE_DRIVE_COPY: Recreate subfolder structure (imported files, reports, printable documents) and copy binary assets using drive.files.copy with supportsAllDrives=true.
summaryVariables.LINK_INTEGRITY_STRATEGY: IMMUTABLE_FILE_MAPPING: Store oldFileId-to-newFileId mapping in storage history and resolve file links dynamically via active storage pointer or historical mapping lookup.
summaryVariables.RBAC_MODEL: Strict RBAC: SUPER_ADMIN and assigned PROJECT_ADMIN can initiate storage changes or archive downloads; SITE_SUPERVISOR and OPERATIONAL users are DENIED.
summaryVariables.ROLLBACK_STRATEGY: ZERO_POINTER_SWITCH_ON_FAILURE: Active storage pointer in Firestore is NEVER updated until 100% verification passes. If failure occurs, old storage remains active and partial target files are flagged for idempotent retry.
summaryVariables.NEXT_IMPLEMENTATION_BLOCK: BLOCK 100G-B — Configurable Project Storage & Archive Implementation

currentStorageArchitecture.storageRootDefinition: Top-level Google Drive folder identified by settings.googleDriveFolderId, housing subfolders ('imported files', 'reports', 'printable documents') and the Master Google Sheet (settings.googleSpreadsheetId).

fields.currentStorageFolderId: string (Google Drive folder ID currently active)
fields.migrationStatus: IDLE | REQUESTED | VALIDATING | COPYING | VERIFYING | READY_TO_SWITCH | SWITCHED | FAILED | ROLLBACK_REQUIRED

fields.changedBy: { userId: string, email: string, role: string }

migrationStateMachine.switchTriggerCondition: Active storage pointer switches ONLY when state reaches READY_TO_SWITCH and verification check passes 100%. Active pointer NEVER changes during COPYING or FAILED states.

archivePackageSpecification.securityFilter: MUST NEVER include OAuth tokens, service account keys, client secrets, password hashes, or Firebase credentials.
